Put the phone away briefly and listen before photographing. This historic garden sits on a Saratoga hillside, where stone steps and gravel are part of the landscape, so choosing a suitable route matters.

成人 18–64 岁 $15、65+ $12、5–17 岁 $10、4 岁及以下: Admission is $15 for ages 18–64, $12 for ages 65+, $10 for ages 5–17, and free for children 4 and under. First-Tuesday resident admission is for Saratoga residents with government photo ID showing a local address, not all Santa Clara County residents.

沿开放路径选择池边或较平缓的观景点，观察树、石与建筑怎样组成画面。官网有池塘整修: Use open paths to reach a pond-side or gentler viewpoint. Notice how trees, stones and buildings form a scene. Check current pond conditions and access because the garden has a renovation project.

只在开放区域加一小段，不追求走遍所有高低路径。回到入口整理照片，想吃东西用指定野: Add only a short open section rather than every uphill and downhill path. Return to the entrance, use the designated picnic area for food, and leave by your planned transport.
园方提供无障碍停车和卫生间，但历史地形并非全园无障碍；上山入口路也有急弯与坡度。: Accessible parking and restrooms are available, but the historic terrain is not fully accessible, and the entry road has bends and slopes. Follow parking signs and contact the gift shop about specific needs. Stay on paths, avoid sitting on bridge rails or climbing rocks, and check permits for commercial or formal portrait photography. Each person can choose a favorite framed view and explain their choice afterwards.
